pairs.structure_narrative: Acquirer forms a Delaware merger subsidiary; the merger sub merges WITH AND INTO Target; Target survives as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Acquirer. No transfer of Target's contracts occurs at the contract level — Target remains the contracting entity, only its equity ownership changes.

clauses.text: "Assignment" means any transfer, conveyance, or delegation of this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether voluntary, involuntary, by operation of law, or otherwise.

This Agreement may not be assigned by either party, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the other party. Any purported assignment in violation of this Section shall be null and void.

WHEREAS, the contemplated transaction is structured as a reverse triangular merger under Section 251 of the Delaware General Corporation Law, in which a wholly-owned Delaware merger subsidiary of the Acquirer will merge with and into TargetCo, Inc., with TargetCo surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Acquirer.

pairs.structure_narrative: Target merges WITH AND INTO Acquirer (or into a non-surviving acquirer subsidiary); Target ceases to exist as a separate legal entity. Target's contracts transfer to the surviving entity by operation of state merger statutes — which under Cincom and PPG IS treated as an assignment by operation of law for non-assignable licenses.

clauses.text: "Assignment" means any transfer, conveyance, or delegation of this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether voluntary, involuntary, by operation of law, or otherwise.

This Agreement may not be assigned by either party, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the other party. Any purported assignment in violation of this Section shall be null and void.

WHEREAS, the contemplated transaction is structured as a forward merger in which TargetCo, Inc. shall merge with and into Acquirer (or a non-surviving subsidiary of Acquirer), with TargetCo ceasing to exist as a separate legal entity and all of its rights and obligations under contracts vesting in the surviving entity by operation of the applicable state merger statute.
